places.description: BYOB paint-and-sip studio with a public class almost every day; bring your own wine and snacks and they supply glasses, ice and corkscrews.

places.name: Puffin Cultural Forum
places.hours_text: Gallery Tuesday-Friday 11 AM - 4 PM (hours may vary, call ahead)
places.description: Small arts center with a photography gallery and cheap or free concerts, workshops and a recurring Open Stage open mic.

places.name: Kaplen JCC on the Palisades
places.description: Community center whose arts calendar runs concerts by the Thurnauer School of Music, youth theater, film nights and craft workshops, most open to non-members.

places.name: Board & Brush Creative Studio
places.description: BYOB studio where an instructor walks you through sanding, staining and painting a wood sign; open-registration workshops run about three hours.

places.name: Untamed Arts
places.description: Craft studio running several workshops a week, from pottery wheel nights and clay trinket trays to sewing lessons and cyanotype printing.

places.name: The Roosevelt
places.hours_text: Closed Monday and Tuesday; happy hour Wed-Sat 3-6 PM; Lucy's Parlor speakeasy Thu-Sun 3 PM - 1 AM
places.description: Art deco restaurant and saloon with a hidden speakeasy, Lucy's Parlor, and live acoustic acts or DJs most nights Wednesday to Saturday.

places.name: Vesta Wood-Fired
places.description: Wood-fired restaurant that books solo and duo acts for 6:30 PM dinner sets on Friday and Saturday.

places.name: GoodFellas Restaurant
places.description: Garfield restaurant with early-evening live music during dinner, often acoustic acts around 6:30 or 7 PM.

places.name: FB & Son's Restaurant
places.description: Route 46 restaurant and lounge (also billed as Fat-B & Sons) that books cover bands and acoustic acts for early evening sets.

places.name: Lou's Tavern
places.description: Hillsdale tavern that hosts live bands, including Grateful Dead tribute nights.

places.name: Gerry's Place
places.description: Norwood bar with Saturday night cover bands starting around 9 PM, from classic rock to country.

places.name: Dominick's Restaurant & Bar
places.description: Restaurant and bar with weekend bands at 8 PM; reservations are recommended on music nights.

places.name: Ivy Inn Restaurant
places.description: Hasbrouck Heights restaurant that hosts early-evening live music during dinner.

places.name: Lenora's Bar
places.description: Hackensack neighborhood bar that books live bands, including Grateful Dead tribute nights.

places.name: 82 Oak Bar & Bistro
places.description: Garfield bar and bistro with a Wednesday night band series.

places.name: Hansil's Bar & Grill
places.description: Oakland bar and grill that books rock and pop cover bands on Saturday nights.

places.name: Redd's
places.description: Bar and restaurant near the Meadowlands whose second-floor room hosts recurring stand-up comedy shows with no drink minimum.

places.name: Ridgewood Art Institute
places.description: Member-run art institute with rotating gallery shows, free receptions and paid artist demos.

places.name: The Art School at Old Church
places.hours_text: Galleries open Mon-Fri 9:15 AM - 5:30 PM and 7 - 10 PM, Sat 10 AM - 3 PM
places.description: Art school in a converted church with two galleries and the annual Old Church Pottery Show each December.

places.name: Players Guild of Leonia
places.description: Community theater in its 107th season, staging plays, improv and musical showcases in the historic Civil War Drill Hall.

places.name: Hackensack Performing Arts Center
places.description: City-run theater (HACPAC) with improv comedy, family holiday shows and concerts at community prices.

places.name: West Side Presbyterian Church (concert venue)
places.description: The main classical hall in Ridgewood: home to Parlance Chamber Concerts, the Ridgewood Symphony, Pro Arte Chorale dates and the church's own free West Side Concert Series.
